WITH driver_totals AS (
  SELECT r.driverId,
         SUM(r.points) AS points_total,
         AVG(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps
  FROM results AS r
  WHERE r.grid >= 12
  GROUP BY r.driverId
)
SELECT AVG(points_total) AS average_points_total,
       AVG(avg_laps) AS average_of_average_laps
FROM driver_totals;
